messages:
maya: Quick sync — need to freeze observability scope for next sprint. Customers want per-route cost, model-version error slices, and a tracing hook for high-p95 flows.

aj: Propose 3 tracks: cost dashboard (aggregated buckets), errors dashboard (model-version slicing), tracing hooks (header-driven sampling).

leo: Recommend default 1% sampling with adaptive bump on spikes. Ops impact: estimated +15-25% trace retention; will model after we lock QPS.

sophia: For cost, avoid per-token writes. Use 1-min aggregated counters per route+model variant. Supports near-RT and CSV export.

caroline: Pilot customers require CSV export and model-version slicing — gating for pilot participation.

nina: UX: ship focused dashboards first (cost/errors/traces) with consistent nav; easier to deliver.

maya: Draft acceptance criteria: cost per-route/model CSV export; errors top slices + sample traces; tracing UI link-out + 1% default. Canary: 2 pilot accounts + internal traffic for 48h, queries >=98% success.

aj: Effort: cost dashboard ~4 dev-weeks, tracing hooks ~3, cost beta ~3-5 depending on aggregation. Add feature flags and per-account rollout.

leo: I'll own rollout & circuit breaker: staging 72h, opt-in pilots 48h, then ramp. Abort if query latency >30% or storage IO >25%.

sophia: I'll draft pipeline spec and sample queries.

caroline: I'll confirm pilot timeline (customer asks for 8-week pilot).

maya: Decision: move forward with cut (no raw token retention in v1). I'll update roadmap and PR acceptance criteria. deploy-bot: scheduling tracing sampler test in staging in 30m.
